request.description: 645 kg of orders vs 500 kg capacity: every HIGH and MEDIUM order is assigned; leftover LOW orders appear in unassignedOrders.

Accepted, but GET /plan lists it in unassignedOrders: exceeds the largest vehicle capacity.
